tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: The datasets this server searches (NAND, DRAM and HBM dies, controllers, hard drives, standards, company results, fab sites), with how many records each holds and the page that shows them.

tools.name: search_records
tools.description: Find sourced figures by words that must all appear in a record (maker, part, measure, company, quarter, site), e.g. "Samsung V9 layers" or "SK hynix revenue 2026-Q3". Up to 50 records per call, each with its source URL and an Eyes on Flash cite.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: Every figure for one record: a die, controller, drive or standard (record_id), a fab site (site_id), a company (company) or a ledger claim (claim_id), within one dataset.
